audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer described the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol: 'Starsurge', 'orbit stacking', 'orbit range', 'orbit damage', and a 'global ultimate' that lets him 'reposition across the map'. None of those exist in his current kit. The full layer named only Astral Flight and never mentioned Singularity's execute at all. spikes[3] also carried a mojibake 'AS?SoL'.
audit.why: His current kit is Cosmic Creator (Stardust), Breath of Light (Q, a 750-range channel on a 3s cooldown), Astral Flight (W, 22s at rank 1, flies over terrain), Singularity (E, 12s, 90 mana, 750 range, a black hole that pulls and whose centre executes below a health percentage), and Falling Star at 1250 range upgrading into The Skies Descend with enough Stardust. He does not reposition across the map with his ultimate.
audit.corrected: Every content field rewritten onto the real kit; full layer now names Breath of Light, Singularity, Falling Star and The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers, and Breath of Light's channel — the thing Charm actually beats — was never named as interruptible.
audit.why: Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s, Singularity 12s at 90 mana, Falling Star 120/110/100s, Breath of Light a 3s-cooldown channel that CC ends.

audit.whatIsWrong: Singularity's percent-health execute and its indifference to resistances were absent.
